internships.title: Growth / Lead Generation Internship
internships.details:
OPTERA (OPTERAI LABS PRIVATE LIMITED) is a DPIIT-recognised AI startup in Ahmedabad. We help bus, truck and tanker fleet operators run their daily operations in one place: maintenance, reports and more.

We are looking for a Growth / Lead Generation Intern to help us find new customers. This is a remote internship for 3 months.

What you will do:

  • Find fleet business owners using AI tools like Apollo, LinkedIn and Google Maps
  • Build a clean lead list in Google Sheets with name, company, phone and city
  • Reach out on WhatsApp, email and calls to book demo meetings with our founder
  • Follow up with leads and track daily numbers:

internships.title: Video Editor Internship
internships.details:
CloseKart Private Limited is hiring for Video Editor Intern

About the Company

CloseKart Private Limited is seeking a creative Video Editor to support social media marketing content. This remote internship is an opportunity to shape short-form and other digital video assets that help communicate ideas clearly and engage online audiences. The internship is unpaid and runs for four months. Applicants from a fresher background are welcome, and prior experience is not required.

Responsibilities

  • Edit videos for CloseKart's digital marketing and promotional activities.

jobs.title: Web Application Developer
jobs.details:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Web Application Developer with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing, maintaining, and optimizing dynamic web applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and PHP, along with experience in responsive UI development, API integration, website performance optimization, and web analytics tools.

The candidate will be responsible for developing user-friendly, responsive, and high-performance web applications while ensuring code quality, functionality, and cross-browser compatibility.
